copy.tagline_en: Compare prices, evaluate vendors, and detect scams on AliExpress
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently shop, sell, or dropship on AliExpress

howto.what: 装上本技能后，当你需要处理AliExpress上的购物、销售或代发货时，Claude会帮你分析卖家信誉、比较价格、计算实际到岸成本、识别常见诈骗模式，并指导你进行争议申诉。
howto.when: 当你询问关于AliExpress的购物、销售、代发货或供应商评估等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个卖家的可信度
say.note: 会检查店铺年龄、粉丝数、回复率等5项指标。

say.text: 比较这两款商品的实际到岸成本
say.note: 计算商品价格+运费+进口税+手续费。

say.text: 这个超低价商品是不是骗局？
say.note: 识别价格过低、本地仓无证明等常见诈骗模式。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can evaluate vendors, compare prices, compute landed costs, detect scams, and guide disputes for AliExpress purchases, selling, or dropshipping.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about AliExpress shopping, selling, dropshipping, or vendor evaluation.

say_en.note: Checks 5 signals including store age, followers, response rate.

say_en.text: Compare the landed cost of these two items.
